q.songTitle: That’s Just the Way That I Feel
q.line: And as the pace of life keeps quickening
stanza: Course I've been humbled by the void
Much of my faith has been destroyed
I've been forced to watch my foes enjoy
Ceaseless feasts of schadenfreude
And as the pace of life keeps quickening
Beneath the bitching and the bickering
When I try to drown my thoughts in gin
I find my worst ideas know how to swim

partner.line: Beneath the bitching and the bickering

q.line: The talk in town's becoming downright sickening
stanza: The lines are fading in my kingdom
(Though I have never known the way to border them in);
So the muddy mouths of baboons and sows, and the grouse, and the horse, and the…
Grope at the gate of the looming lake that was once a tidy pen
And the mail is late, and the great estates are not lit from within
The talk in town's becoming downright sickening

partner.line: And the mail is late, and the great estates are not lit from within

q.songTitle: That’s Just the Way That I Feel
q.line: You see, the life I live is sickening
stanza: Well, I don't like talkin’ to myself
But someone's gotta say it, hell
I mean, things have not been going well
This time I think I finally fucked myself
You see, the life I live is sickening
I spent a decade playing chicken with oblivion
Day to day, I'm neck and neck with giving in
I’m the same old wreck I've always been

partner.line: I spent a decade playing chicken with oblivion
